description: One-day course (7 h) for web editors and staff who publish content, up to eight people, in their own publishing tool. Participants structure a page with headings, lists and clear links, write text alternatives for images, prepare a simple table and an accessible document, and check the result against a grid.
title: Contributeurs : publier accessible (Publishing accessible content)
topics: Accessible headings, links, images, tables and documents
